notes.text: You can now use a controller extension hook to react to event-driven side effects received using a WebSocket
We now dynamically adjust the decimal padding for currencies based on the currency codelist
We now ensure that the table works correctly when a variant is applied on a list report page with multiple tabs
We've resolved an issue where intent-based navigation used an incorrect value for fields with TextOnly text arrangement in header facets
We now ensure that cross-application back navigation works correctly in the SAP Build Work Zone iframe
